batch_note: This is trial 1 of a formal n=5 batch for Condition B. Do not treat this file as batch-level completion evidence on its own.

manual_observation.startup_asynchrony_note: The two robots' avoidance maneuvers themselves were synchronized, but epuck1 (bottom-left) visibly began moving noticeably earlier than epuck2 (top-right) at the start of the trial.
manual_observation.observer: user, real-time visual observation of the single Webots run
manual_observation.other_notes: Avoidance itself synchronized; only the initial movement start showed a visible asynchrony (epuck1 before epuck2).

revision_note.reason: The original manual_observation.note text (generated by reusing the Condition-A-batch finalize script's default text without overriding it for this manually-launched trial) incorrectly stated this trial was 'not individually observed' and 'part of an automated batch' -- both false for Condition B Trial 01, which was launched manually by the user for individual observation. First corrected to a PENDING status, then updated again to RECEIVED with the user's actual observation once reported, including the specific 'epuck1 starts moving before epuck2' asynchrony note the user asked to be preserved. No automated measurement field in this file was altered by either correction.

trigger_mechanism_audit.safe_stop_stale_characterization: benign pre-encounter startup transient, confined to ros_time~23-26s, well before the first AVOID_TURN at ros_time=36.660s

startup_sync_audit.condition_A_comparison: Present in all 5 Condition A trials too (range 0.06s-2.7s, sign not fixed -- Trial 04 shows epuck2 leading by +2.66s, essentially the same magnitude as this trial's -2.64s but opposite direction). Condition B Trial 01 is NOT an outlier relative to Condition A's own distribution.
startup_sync_audit.root_cause: Both cooperative_avoider instances launch via the same LaunchDescription/LaunchService call -- the offset is consistent with ordinary OS-level process-spawn/scheduling variance, not a deterministic ordering bug and not caused by the 0.20s relay delay (STARTUP_HOLD exit is a fixed timer independent of relay delay by design).
startup_sync_audit.impact_on_measured_metrics: None identified -- AVOID_TURN/RECOVER deltas are exactly 0.000s in every audited trial, so the encounter phase (where communication metrics are measured) is unaffected by the startup-phase offset.

final_confirmed_verdict_note: Manual observation received and consistent with the automated evidence for avoidance/safety: avoidance completed, no collision, no spinning/oscillation, recovered and auto-stopped normally, no desynchronization DURING the avoidance maneuver itself. However, the user separately observed a visible startup asynchrony (epuck1 began moving noticeably before epuck2) -- this trial's TRIAL_PASS on strict automated criteria stands, but Trial 02 is deliberately withheld pending an offline startup-timing-synchronization audit (objective5_conditionB_trial01_startup_sync_audit.{json,md}) before the batch may proceed, per instruction.
